follow_up_policy: After any formal metric is viewed, do not alter the 20% sleeves, asset identities, rebalance cadence or add timing filters. Other fixed portfolios or factor mixes require separate preregistered economic hypotheses.
forbidden_changes: 15/25/30% sleeve alternatives or any weight optimization
substituting QQQ, IWD, QUAL, MTUM or another factor after results
replacing T-bill with IEF/SHY after results
shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage or gross exposure above 100%
hypothesis: A fixed equal-weight mix of broad U.S. equity, small-cap value, long Treasuries, short Treasury bills and gold can combine the Permanent Portfolio all-regime defense with a dedicated small-cap-value return premium. Annual rebalancing should preserve low turnover while harvesting cross-asset diversification and the long-only value premium, potentially improving CAGR versus the Permanent Portfolio without sacrificing drawdown control.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
max realized gross <=100% and minimum cash >=0
research_basis: Portfolio Charts Golden Butterfly: 20% large-cap/total-market stocks, 20% small-cap value, 20% long Treasuries, 20% short Treasuries, 20% gold
Fama-French-style small/value premium provides the extra growth sleeve; this trial uses the published fixed architecture rather than fitting weights
selection_metric: No weight or cadence search. Exactly five 20% sleeves and annual rebalance. External published performance is known, but no internal CNY/cost result has been viewed. Validation, objective and SPY comparison remain separate ATM-SVP-3 axes.
